To become a POSP agent with PolicyNest, you need to upload six required documents on the Documents step:

1. PAN card (an individual PAN)
2. Aadhaar card (front photo)
3. Aadhaar card (back photo)
4. Class 10 or 12 marksheet from a recognised school board
5. Bank proof in your name (cancelled cheque, passbook first page, or bank statement)
6. A clear selfie

Make sure photos are taken on a flat surface in good light with all four corners visible. 

I do not have your saved progress yet. Could you tell me which step you are currently on, or are you just getting started?

PolicyNest POSP बनने के लिए आपको ये दस्तावेज़ अपलोड करने होंगे:

1. **PAN card** (व्यक्तिगत)
2. **Aadhaar card** (आगे और पीछे की फोटो)
3. **10वीं या 12वीं की मार्कशीट**
4. **बैंक प्रूफ** (कैंसिल्ड चेक, पासबुक का पहला पन्ना या बैंक स्टेटमेंट)
5. **Selfie** (साफ़ और अच्छे प्रकाश में)

आवेदन के लिए आपकी उम्र कम से कम 18 वर्ष और 10वीं पास होना ज़रूरी है। 

अभी आपका कोई सेव्ड प्रोग्रेस नहीं दिख रहा है। आप अभी किस स्टेप पर हैं? आवेदन शुरू करने के लिए **Your details** से शुरुआत करें और फिर **Documents** स्क्रीन पर अपलोड करें।

To apply as a PolicyNest POSP insurance agent, you must meet a few requirements:
1. You must be at least 18 years old on the date you start your application.
2. You must have passed Class 10 (secondary school) from a recognised board, including NIOS.
3. You need a valid individual PAN card and a savings or current bank account in your own name.
4. You must not already be registered as a POSP with another insurer or intermediary.

4. On the Documents screen, find your Aadhaar front card and tap Replace to upload the new photo.

Here is what to do next:
